standards.name: Published to Developer Portal
test: Export the API list from the internal service registry and open the API catalog on the enterprise developer portal
Cross-reference the portal's published API count against the Architecture integration catalog in Confluence
Open the portal pages for three recently delivered APIs including one consumed by an agency or broker partner
Confirm each page links a versioned OpenAPI spec, usage guide, changelog, and active sandbox environment
Open the release workflow for two API-producing services in GitHub Actions and locate the automated portal-publish step
Search the developer portal for a business term such as policy or claim and inspect the top result for stale duplicates
Pass when every registry API is published with guide and sandbox, publish is automated, and search shows no stale active versions

standards.name: Pull Request Required for Main and Develop
test: Open Settings > Branches on each repository in GitHub Enterprise and inspect the protection rules for main and develop
Confirm both branches require a pull request, at least one approval, and have Include administrators enabled
Run a direct git push to main and then develop from an administrator account on one representative repository
Export 20 merge events to main and develop from the prior 60 days across at least four repos via the GitHub Enterprise audit log
Open each sampled merge in GitHub Enterprise and check the PR has required approvals, a passing CI check, and a distinct author
Pass when both direct pushes are rejected, protection settings match policy, and all 20 merges trace to compliant PRs

standards.name: Quality Gates
test: Open the pipeline workflow YAML in GitHub Actions and check fail conditions for tests, coverage, High severity scans, and lint
Push a branch with a known vulnerable dependency, then open the run in GitHub Actions and confirm it fails and blocks promotion
List builds promoted to production-bound environments in the past 90 days in the GitHub Actions deployments view
Open the linked exception record in ServiceNow ITSM for any promotion lacking a passing gate and check team-lead approval
Review the workflow settings in GitHub Actions and confirm no unconditional manual override or bypass path exists
Pass when gates are codified, the seeded failure blocks promotion, and promoted builds all pass or hold approved exceptions

standards.name: README Covers Purpose, Setup, Run, Test, and Deploy
test: Open the root README of each repository under review in GitHub Enterprise
Check each README for Purpose/Business Capability, Setup, Run Locally, Test, and Deploy sections, flagging placeholders
Follow only the README on a clean workstation in VS Code to reach a running local instance, logging any undocumented step
Cross-reference the stated business capability against the value-stream catalog in Confluence
Pass when every README has all five sections, a local instance runs with zero undocumented steps, and a real capability is named

standards.name: RED Metrics (Rate, Errors, Duration)
test: Query rate, error, and latency series for every production service in the service inventory in the Datadog metrics explorer
Check the prior 7-day window in Datadog for gaps in any service's rate, error, or latency series, targeting zero gaps
Open the metric definitions for three sampled services in Datadog and confirm p50, p95, and p99 latency, not mean only
Open the published SLOs for two services in Datadog and confirm thresholds cite p95 or p99 latency and error rate
Open the incident triage runbook for one sampled service in Confluence and confirm RED metrics are the first-tier signals
Pass when services emit gap-free RED metrics for 7 days, latency is percentile-based, and SLOs reference p95/p99 and error rate

standards.name: RESTful Design
test: Open the OpenAPI specification for each API on the developer portal and list every operation and its HTTP method
Confirm only GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE appear, GET has no request body, and PATCH/PUT semantics are correct
Run a sample of 10 calls covering each method in use via the API gateway test console and record the status codes
Check policy, claim, and billing URI paths for noun-based hierarchy and zero RPC-style verbs like /createPolicy
Run an SSL Labs scan against each API hostname and confirm HTTPS-only with TLS 1.2 minimum enforced at the gateway
Pass when specs use only standard methods, the 10 calls return correct status codes, URIs are noun-based, and TLS 1.2+ holds

standards.name: RFC 7807 Problem Details Format
test: Submit a malformed policy number to an underwriting, a claims, and a billing endpoint via the API gateway test console
Confirm each error response is application/problem+json with type, title, status, detail, and instance members
Open the OpenAPI specification on the developer portal and confirm extensions like declineReasonCode are documented
Export the last 30 days of error logs from the API gateway and sample 20 4xx/5xx responses
Check each sampled response for legacy formats such as plain text, custom JSON, or HTML, targeting zero
Pass when all triggered errors are RFC 7807 compliant, extensions are documented, and zero sampled responses are legacy

standards.name: Refresh Schedule Defined
test: Open the published refresh schedule in Confluence for five production reports spanning financial and claims domains
Confirm each schedule states cadence, data-as-of timestamp, and the upstream pipeline dependency
Export the last 30 days of refresh and pipeline run logs from Airflow for the sampled reports
Compare run timestamps to confirm no report refresh started before its upstream dependency completed
Survey a sample of report consumers via Microsoft Forms on where the schedule is published and the data-as-of timing
Pass when all five reports state all three fields, no refresh preceded upstream completion, and consumers answer correctly

standards.name: Required Tags: Owner, CostCenter, Environment
test: Run a tag-compliance scan across all subscriptions and accounts in the cloud governance tool (Azure Policy) and export results
Check the export shows 0% of resources missing Owner, CostCenter, or Environment tag values
Compare tag values against the enterprise reference data export (cost-center list, environment enum), targeting 0% invalid
Open the remediation queue in ServiceNow ITSM and check every flagged resource has an assigned ticket with a due date
Confirm no unresolved tag violation in ServiceNow ITSM is older than the 5 business day remediation SLA
Pass when 0% of resources are untagged, 0% carry out-of-catalog values, and no violation exceeds the remediation SLA

standards.name: Requirements Documented
test: Open the requirements pages in Confluence for five sampled reports including at least one statutory or NAIC-linked report
Verify each contains business question, audience, source data, calculations, regulatory context, and owner approval
Open the earliest development artifact for each report in Jira and compare its creation date to the approval date
Cross-check any cited statutory or NAIC obligation against the regulatory filing inventory in Confluence
Pass when all six sections are present and signed, approval pre-dates development, and citations match the inventory

standards.name: Root Cause Analysis
test: Filter the data quality issue register in Jira for all issues at or above the defined severity threshold
Confirm each above-threshold issue links a completed RCA document in Confluence with author, date, and version
Open three sampled RCA documents in Confluence and check separate labeled sections for record correction and systemic cause
Verify each sampled RCA names the specific source field, pipeline job and step, or business process ID at fault
Open each RCA's corrective action in Jira and confirm an owner, a due date, and a status matching the stated resolution
Pass when every above-threshold issue has a complete RCA with separated sections, a precise origin, and a tracked action

standards.name: Runbook Linked
test: Export the full alert inventory from PagerDuty and check every alert definition has a non-empty, reachable runbook URL
Open the linked runbooks in Confluence for 10 sampled paging alerts including two touching claims payments or policyholder data
Confirm each runbook covers diagnosis steps, remediation options, and escalation contacts with a business escalation path
Submit a test alert definition with no runbook URL through the promotion pipeline in GitHub Actions and confirm rejection
Review the last 30 days of merged alert-definition PRs in GitHub Enterprise and check each carried a runbook link at merge
Pass when all alerts link reachable runbooks, sampled runbooks are complete, and the runbook-absent test alert is blocked

standards.name: Schema Evolution Handled
test: Open the data contracts in Confluence for the five highest-volume feeds and check each documents schema-evolution handling
Add a new nullable column to one feed's source schema in the non-production database and run the pipeline end-to-end
Confirm in the pipeline run logs that the run succeeds, the column is captured or ignored, and no failure alert fires
Rename or drop a required column in the non-production source schema and rerun the same pipeline
Confirm the run fails with an error naming the column and feed, and check the alert was delivered in PagerDuty
Check the last five merged pipeline PRs in GitHub Enterprise for required schema-contract test results such as dbt tests
Pass when all five contracts document handling, the additive run succeeds, and the breaking run fails loudly with an alert

standards.name: Searchable
test: Run five searches in the enterprise data catalog using business terms like incurred loss and a known table name and tag
Record the result rank of the expected authoritative asset for each query, targeting the top five results
Run the metadata completeness report in the enterprise data catalog and check blank descriptions or tags stay under 10%
Open the curation log in the enterprise data catalog and confirm a stale or duplicate sweep within the past 180 days
Pass when all five queries hit the top five, completeness is at least 90%, and a curation sweep is logged within 180 days

standards.name: Searchable Metadata
test: Pull a random sample of 20 assets from the enterprise data catalog and open each asset's metadata page
Confirm 100% of the 20 have non-empty schema, description, classification, and at least one quality indicator
Run keyword and domain-filter searches in the catalog for three insurance terms such as earned premium and loss ratio
Run the metadata freshness report in the enterprise data catalog and flag assets not updated within the 90-day threshold
Open remediation tickets in Jira for flagged assets and five prior-quarter defects and check open assignment or signed closure
Pass when all 20 samples are fully populated, all three searches return assets, and stale or defect items are ticketed or closed

standards.name: Secure Configuration Baseline
test: Open the configuration baseline repository in GitHub Enterprise and confirm an approved baseline per supported OS platform
Check the latest baseline commit in GitHub Enterprise references a change ticket and a peer-reviewed pull request
Run the Chef InSpec compliance scan against ten random production hosts spanning at least two OS platforms
Record each host's drift results from the scan, targeting zero unexcepted deviations
Open the remediation tracker in ServiceNow ITSM and check systems were fixed within SLA or hold a signed exception with expiry
Pass when baselines are versioned and change-managed, sampled hosts show zero unexcepted drift, and no remediation is overdue

standards.name: Security Exception Process
test: Export all active and closed exceptions from the security exception register in ServiceNow ITSM
Check each entry for owner risk acceptance, compensating controls, CISO approval, expiry date, and re-review date
Verify compensating controls for five sampled active exceptions by opening the cited artifact such as a firewall rule or alert
Filter the register for expired entries lacking a renewal, closure, or escalation decision, targeting zero
Cross-check waived vulnerability tickets in ServiceNow ITSM against register entries to confirm no shadow exceptions
Pass when every exception is fully documented and approved, sampled controls are live, and zero expired or shadow items exist

standards.name: SonarQube Gates Enforced
test: Open each in-scope project's Quality Gate screen in SonarQube and confirm the enterprise-standard gate is assigned
Open the latest main-branch run for each repo in GitHub Actions and confirm the SonarQube gate step is a required check
Verify in GitHub Actions that any recent gate failure blocked the build from proceeding to deployment
Attempt to lower a project's gate stringency in SonarQube without an approved exception and note the block or audit entry
Review the gate-change audit log in SonarQube for any unapproved looser configuration in history
Pass when every project uses the standard gate, the gate blocks deployment on failure, and no unapproved loosening exists
